text:
laura: Quick heads-up — starting a role-slimming sprint next week to reduce admin/privileged principals across infra. Goal: remove stale admin roles, ensure least-priv for service accounts, and validate KMS key access. Looking for owners for each shard. Proposed process: export current admins, run a 2-week canary prune on non-prod, run audit logs to detect blocked operations, then schedule prod prune with rollback. Volunteers?

ashwin: I can own infra svcaccts and GCP roles. What's the export command?

laura: use gcloud iam + bigquery for audit traces. Quick snippet:
```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy $PROJECT --format=json > policy.json
bq query --nouse_legacy_sql '
SELECT protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, protoPayload.methodName
FROM `project.logs.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity_*`
WHERE timestamp > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
AND protoPayload.methodName LIKE "%SetIamPolicy%"
'
```
Also map KMS key access via: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` and export bindings.

maria: What about service accounts used by data pipelines? need owner approval before removing.

sam: +1. Suggest tagging time-sensitive svcaccts with label `keep=true` to avoid accidental prune.

ashwin: We should also check KMS IAM bindings — some keys have broader permissions than necessary. I can generate a key-access matrix.

laura: Good. Rollout plan: 1) export & map owners (week 0), 2) create prune RFC and PRs (week 1), 3) run canary prune in staging & dev (week 2), 4) monitor audit/alerts for 72h, 5) escalation & rollback window (72h), 6) prod prune (week 3). Concerns: HSM-backed keys require a ticket with security to rotate.

security-bot: Note: KMS access grants are logged under "google.iam.v1.Binding" events — ensure audit retention is set to 180d. :warning: 

maria: How to handle cross-project roles for onboarding accounts? Eg analytics svcacct in shared project.

laura: We'll maintain a whitelist CSV for cross-project principals. Any change touching shared roles requires approver from platform team.

kate: Curious about audit noise — if we prune and then pipelines fail they will spike errors. Are we going to create temporary slack channel and set runbook?

laura: Yes — #eng-security-role-slimming will be created; runbook will include quick restore steps:
```
# restore binding
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT --member="serviceAccount:svc@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/editor"
# restore KMS binding
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding $KEY --member="serviceAccount:..." --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"
```
We'll prefer minimal roles when restoring then audit.

sam: For automation — do we have an existing bot to remove stale entries or do manual PRs?

laura: We'll generate PRs to the central identity repo with proposed removals. Ops will review. If no owner responds in 7 days, mark as orphan and candidate for removal after 14 days.

ashwin: Can I get permission to run discovery scripts? Need access to logs dataset.

laura: I'll grant bigquery.dataViewer to your account for discovery. Tagging @ashwin.

infra-bot: scheduled job "role-slimming-discovery" created for 2026-04-10 02:00 UTC

maria: One more Q — KMS key ACLs: any key with more than one non-service principal should be flagged for rotation?

security-bot: Policy: keys with external principals > 1 or with "roles/cloudkms.admin" assigned should be reviewed and rotated per KMS rotation playbook. :white_check_mark:

laura: OK assign owners: ashwin=infra svcaccts, maria=data svcaccts, sam=platform roles. I'll draft RFC today. Volunteers for PR review on week1?

kate: I can review PRs.

ashwin: I'll run discovery and post results in thread.

laura: thanks all — will create the RFC and the slack channel + calendar invites. Expect discovery artifacts by EOD Thu. :pray:
